<p class="intro">
My research examines how globally authoritative institutions—including science, democracy, and nation-states—acquire divergent cultural meanings in contemporary society. I use large-scale textual archives, cross-national surveys, and social media data, applying neural embeddings, machine learning, and network analysis.
</p>
